phase: Hays grass expansion Phase 2 — final nine literature morphology profiles
scope_and_limitations: Five species directly checked against the user-supplied 1999 regional flora's PDF species treatments; four covered with named external botanical references and the older flora's taxon coverage noted accurately.
Characters describe literature expectations and verification targets, not observations proven on Hays specimens. No new original iNaturalist source photo was examined in this packet.
No public interactive key trait states or new species released. Unknown remains unscored; rights and Hays planted-versus-naturalized questions remain separate.
Lolium × boucheanum remains an unresolved taxon-concept/hybrid-parentage conflict: POWO and EPPO differ. Do not use as a definitive photo-only field endpoint.
